issues.t: High-pressure fuel pump can come loose and leak fuel (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell under the hood, a check engine light, or the engine stalling.
issues.why: The high-pressure fuel pump could separate from its mounting flange and damage the high-pressure fuel line, letting fuel leak in the engine bay and creating a fire risk.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, don't drive it. Have a Buick dealer check your VIN; the recall replaces the pump and fuel pipe for free.

issues.t: Front end shakes when turning from a stop
issues.sym: The front end shakes or shimmies when pulling away from a stop while turning, usually fading by about 15 mph.
issues.why: Owners traced the shake to the front axle half shafts. GM issued a bulletin (18-NA-233) to replace both front half shafts, and a separate bulletin for low-speed wobble in turns.
issues.next: Ask a Buick dealer to check the car against bulletin 18-NA-233. Replacing the front half shafts fixed it for owners.

issues.t: Brake lines at the master cylinder can crack (recall)
issues.sym: A brake warning light, a soft or sinking pedal, or brake fluid under the car.
issues.why: On SUVs built between January 19 and March 18, 2016, the brake lines at the master cylinder could crack and leak fluid, reducing braking.
issues.next: If the pedal goes soft or fluid leaks, don't drive it. Have a dealer confirm the recall line replacement was done.

issues.t: Tablet holder can stop head restraints from locking (recall)
issues.sym: A front head restraint lifts out without pressing its release button.
issues.why: An accessory tablet holder mounted on the front head restraints may have been installed so the restraint posts don't fully lock, so they could loosen in a crash.
issues.next: Ask a Buick dealer to inspect and reinstall the head restraints and holder under the recall.

issues.t: Replacement headliner may lack impact foam (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom; the problem is hidden above the headliner.
issues.why: Some replacement headliners were missing the energy-absorbing foam blocks that protect heads in a crash.
issues.next: Have a dealer check your VIN for this recall.

issues.t: Tire and loading label shows the wrong weight limit (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom; the label on the door frame lists an incorrect maximum load.
issues.why: On SUVs built February 4 to April 25, 2016, the label could lead an owner to overload the vehicle.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to replace the label. Don't load the SUV to the limit on the label until it is checked.

issues.t: A/C blows hot air to the rear seat
issues.sym: Air from the rear vents is warm while the front may still feel cool, or cooling fades overall.
issues.why: Owners of the 2017 model report A/C failures, usually involving major A/C system parts.
issues.next: Have the A/C diagnosed and get a written estimate, and ask whether any warranty or goodwill coverage applies.

issues.t: Fuel filler door breaks
issues.sym: The fuel door won't open or close properly, or the flap and the area inside it break.
issues.why: Owners of the 2017 model report the fuel filler flap and its housing breaking at low mileage.
issues.next: Have the fuel door assembly replaced; make sure the cap area still seals so you don't get an evaporative check engine light.

issues.t: Service Power Steering message and heavy steering
issues.sym: A Service Power Steering message and steering that suddenly becomes much harder to turn.
issues.why: GM issued a bulletin (17-NA-340) for loss of electric power steering assist with a stored fault code.
issues.next: Steer firmly and slow down; the car can still be steered but takes more effort. Have a dealer check it against the bulletin.

issues.t: Misfire and check engine light from moisture in the charge air cooler
issues.sym: A check engine light, stumbling or misfiring, or low power, often in damp weather.
issues.why: Water condenses inside the intercooler (charge air cooler) that cools air from the turbo, and gets drawn into the engine. GM's bulletin 18NA020 replaces the charge air cooler.
issues.next: Have the codes read. If they match the bulletin, a dealer can replace the charge air cooler.

issues.t: Oil leak from a lower engine bolt
issues.sym: Oil spots under the engine or oily residue near the bottom of the engine.
issues.why: GM issued bulletin 18NA201 for oil seeping past one of the bolts in the engine's lower casing (bedplate). The fix is to seal that bolt.
issues.next: Check the oil level and have the leak traced. Point the shop to bulletin 18NA201.

issues.t: Service Brake Assist message with check engine light
issues.sym: A Service Brake Assist message and/or check engine light, and the brake pedal may feel firmer than usual.
issues.why: GM bulletin 21NA107 covers a fault with the brake booster vacuum sensor circuit (code P0557).
issues.next: Brakes still work but may need more pedal force, so leave extra distance. Have a dealer read the codes and apply the bulletin repair.

issues.t: Electric parking brake won't release or shows a service message
issues.sym: A Service Park Brake or Service ESC message, or the parking brake stays on.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins to replace the rear caliper and parking brake motor when the brake won't release (16NA336) and to recalibrate the system for service messages (19NA213).
issues.next: Don't drive with the parking brake dragging. Have a dealer check the codes against these bulletins.

issues.t: Auto stop/start stops working with a check engine light
issues.sym: The engine no longer shuts off at stops, and a check engine or battery monitor warning may appear.
issues.why: GM bulletins say a stored fault, often tied to the 12-volt battery or its monitoring sensor, disables the stop/start system.
issues.next: Have the battery tested; a weak battery is a common trigger. The shop should then clear and recheck the codes.

issues.t: Rough idle, long cranking or misfire from injector deposits
issues.sym: Rough idle, long cranking before starting, a no-start, or a misfire light.
issues.why: Carbon deposits on the direct fuel injectors disturb the spray. GM bulletin 16-NA-383 calls for a fuel injection cleaning kit.
issues.next: Use Top Tier gasoline. If symptoms show up, ask a dealer about the injector cleaning service in the bulletin.

issues.t: Coolant leak at the coolant control valve
issues.sym: Coolant level dropping, a sweet smell, or coolant crust near the engine's coolant valve.
issues.why: GM issued an engineering bulletin (PIE0782) about coolant leaking around the electronically controlled coolant valve.
issues.next: Keep the coolant topped up with the right type and watch the temperature gauge. Have a dealer check it, since it may be covered by warranty.

issues.t: 9-speed automatic shifts oddly or sets a transmission code
issues.sym: Hesitation, unexpected shifts or comments about 9th gear behavior, sometimes with a check engine light at low mileage.
issues.why: GM bulletins cover low-mileage 9-speed transmissions with control solenoid codes (21-NA-169) and explain normal 9th-gear behavior (21-NA-181).
issues.next: Note when it happens and have the codes read. A dealer can tell normal shift behavior from a solenoid fault.

issues.t: Check engine light in freezing weather from the crankcase pressure sensor
issues.sym: A check engine light (code P04FB) in very cold weather, with no change in how the SUV drives.
issues.why: Moisture condenses in the crankcase pressure sensor and freezes, giving a false reading. GM issued bulletin PIP5841.
issues.next: Have the code read. If it matches, a dealer can apply the bulletin fix.

issues.t: Check engine light for a fuel vapor pressure sensor code
issues.sym: A check engine light with code P0451 and no driving change.
issues.why: GM bulletin 22-NA-203 covers a fault reading from the fuel vapor (EVAP) pressure sensor.
issues.next: Make sure the fuel cap or capless filler is closed properly, then have the code checked against the bulletin.

issues.t: Low turbo boost with code P0299
issues.sym: A check engine light, sluggish acceleration, or low power, sometimes worse in very cold weather.
issues.why: GM bulletins link code P0299 to a charge air bypass valve that sticks open, and cover charge air cooler icing in extreme cold.
issues.next: Have the codes read and the bypass valve checked. Replacing the valve usually restores power.

issues.t: No Fob Detected message and no start
issues.sym: The SUV won't crank or start and shows No Fob Detected even with the key fob inside.
issues.why: GM bulletins trace this to an internal fault in the body control module.
issues.next: Try the fob's backup location (check the owner's manual) to start it. Have a dealer check the body control module under the bulletin.

issues.t: Starter grinds or rattles when starting
issues.sym: A grinding or rattling noise when starting, or the starter not cranking the engine.
issues.why: GM issued bulletins for starter rattle and for starters that grind or fail to crank.
issues.next: Have the starter checked before it leaves you stranded; it may be covered by warranty.

issues.t: Airbag warning light may not work reliably (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light comes on and goes off on its own, or may not warn you of a real fault.
issues.why: The communications gateway module may mishandle a lost connection to the airbag sensing module. A software update fixes it.
issues.next: Have a dealer or an over-the-air update apply the recall software.

issues.t: Daytime running lights stay on with the headlights (recall)
issues.sym: The daytime running lights stay bright when the headlights are on, which can glare at other drivers.
issues.why: Body control module software does not turn the daytime lights off when the headlights come on.
issues.next: Have a dealer or an over-the-air update install the recall software.

issues.t: Infotainment glitches with phone projection, audio or screens
issues.sym: Apple CarPlay or Android Auto black screens or disconnects, lost or crackling audio, Bluetooth problems, slow boot, or camera and display glitches.
issues.why: GM bulletin PIT6362 blames software problems in the infotainment system and says GM is developing updates.
issues.next: Keep the system's software updated. Ask a dealer about the latest update instead of replacing the radio or screens.

issues.t: Navigation and personalization settings unavailable
issues.sym: Turn-by-turn navigation doesn't work, and personal settings are unavailable in the SUV or the mobile app.
issues.why: GM bulletin 25-NA-055 says a software issue blocks these features and that a software fix is being developed.
issues.next: Ask a dealer whether the software fix is available for your VIN.

issues.t: Check engine light or no start from a wiring junction block
issues.sym: A check engine light, or the engine won't crank or start, with code P1682.
issues.why: GM bulletin PIT6486 traces this to an internal fault in the engine wiring harness junction block.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Replacing the junction block is the fix, and it should be covered by warranty.

issues.t: All-weather floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall)
issues.sym: The accelerator pedal sticks or doesn't come back up.
issues.why: A certain all-weather floor mat could trap the accelerator pedal (recall 24E-066). GM also warned that mats made for 2021-2023 Envisions don't fit 2024-2025 models.
issues.next: Remove any extra or poorly fitting driver's mat now. Have a dealer check the mat and do the recall fix.

issues.t: Tire information label missing (recall)
issues.sym: No tire pressure and loading label on the driver's door frame.
issues.why: Some SUVs were built without the label that lists tire size, pressure and load limits.
issues.next: Use the pressures in the owner's manual, and have a dealer install the label.

issues.t: Gear display blank in manual shift mode
issues.sym: When using manual shift mode, the gauge cluster shows no gear number.
issues.why: GM bulletin PIT6518 says engineering is still investigating and no repair is available yet.
issues.next: The SUV is safe to drive. Don't pay for parts; ask the dealer to watch for an updated bulletin.
